Colombia Earthquake: Death Toll Rises, Rescue Efforts Intensify

A 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Colombia, resulting in a death toll that has climbed to at least 254, with reports indicating over 3,900 people missing. Rescuers are actively searching for survivors trapped under rubble in affected cities, including Pereira and Cali. The President has declared a state of emergency in response to the disaster. The earthquake was described as the worst in a decade.
